summary: All generated Markdown is read-only; Markdown-to-JSON Import is removed, including one-to-one configuration pages, and generated documents list source paths, roles and one composite hash.
rationale: User answer to Plan 06 D4. JSON remains the only machine authority; an editable Markdown path creates a second authority and a partial-write risk. A composite hash plus a byte-for-byte re-render check detects staleness without per-source hash churn. Plan 06 section 17 D4; review sections 1, 6.1 and 6.7.
